content:
I'll create a Crossplane XRD and Composition using functions mode with `function-patch-and-transform`. Here's a complete, idiomatic implementation.

## 1. CompositeResourceDefinition (XRD)

```yaml
# xrd.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: CompositeResourceDefinition
metadata:
  name: xappstacks.platform.example.org
spec:
  group: platform.example.org
  names:
    kind: XAppStack
    plural: xappstacks
  claimNames:
    kind: AppStack
    plural: appstacks
  defaultCompositionRef:
    name: appstack-aws
  versions:
    - name: v1alpha1
      served: true
      referenceable: true
      schema:
        openAPIV3Schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            spec:
              type: object
              properties:
                parameters:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    environment:
                      type: string
                      description: Deployment environment.
                      enum: ["dev", "prod"]
                    region:
                      type: string
                      description: AWS region for regional resources.
                      default: "us-east-1"
                    bucketName:
                      type: string
                      description: Globally-unique S3 bucket name.
                    database:
                      type: object
                      properties:
                        instanceClass:
                          type: string
                          default: "db.t3.micro"
                        allocatedStorage:
                          type: integer
                          default: 20
                        multiAZ:
                          type: boolean
                          default: false
                        engineVersion:
                          type: string
                          default: "15.4"
                        masterUsername:
                          type: string
                          default: "appuser"
                      required:
                        - instanceClass
                    oidcProviderArn:
                      type: string
                      description: EKS OIDC provider ARN for IRSA trust.
                    oidcProviderUrl:
                      type: string
                      description: EKS OIDC issuer URL (without https://).
                    serviceAccountNamespace:
                      type: string
                      default: "default"
                    serviceAccountName:
                      type: string
                      default: "app-sa"
                  required:
                    - environment
                    - region
                    - bucketName
                    - oidcProviderArn
                    - oidcProviderUrl
                providerConfigName:
                  type: string
                  description: Name of the AWS ProviderConfig (per env/region).
                  default: "default"
              required:
                - parameters
            status:
              type: object
              properties:
                bucketArn:
                  type: string
                dbEndpoint:
                  type: string
                roleArn:
                  type: string
```

## 2. Composition (Functions Mode)

```yaml
# composition.yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: appstack-aws
  labels:
    provider: aws
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: platform.example.org/v1alpha1
    kind: XAppStack
  mode: Pipeline
  pipeline:
    - step: patch-and-transform
      functionRef:
        name: function-patch-and-transform
      input:
        apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Resources
        resources:

          # ---------------------------------------------------------------
          # S3 Bucket (application assets)
          # ---------------------------------------------------------------
          - name: bucket
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Bucket
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  forceDestroy: false
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
                toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
                toFieldPath: status.bucketArn

          # Versioning enabled
          - name: bucket-versioning
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketVersioning
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  versioningConfiguration:
                    - status: Enabled
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

          # Server-side encryption (AES-256)
          - name: bucket-encryption
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  rule:
                    - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                        - sseAlgorithm: AES256
                      bucketKeyEnabled: true
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

          # Block all public access
          - name: bucket-public-access-block
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  blockPublicAcls: true
                  blockPublicPolicy: true
                  ignorePublicAcls: true
                  restrictPublicBuckets: true
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

          # ---------------------------------------------------------------
          # RDS PostgreSQL
          # ---------------------------------------------------------------
          - name: rds-subnet-group
            base:
              apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: SubnetGroup
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  subnetIdSelector:
                    matchLabels:
                      access: private
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name

          - name: rds-instance
            base:
              apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Instance
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  engine: postgres
                  dbSubnetGroupNameSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  # Security & compliance defaults
                  deletionProtection: true
                  publiclyAccessible: false
                  storageEncrypted: true
                  backupRetentionPeriod: 7
                  skipFinalSnapshot: false
                  finalSnapshotIdentifier: appstack-final
                  storageType: gp3
                  # Password managed by AWS; delivered to connection secret
                  autoGeneratePassword: true
                  passwordSecretRef:
                    namespace: crossplane-system
                    name: appstack-rds-master
                    key: password
                writeConnectionSecretToRef:
                  namespace: crossplane-system
                  name: appstack-rds-conn
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.instanceClass
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.allocatedStorage
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.allocatedStorage
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.multiAZ
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAz
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.engineVersion
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.engineVersion
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.masterUsername
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.username
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
              # Namespaced connection secret per composite
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: metadata.uid
                toFieldPath: spec.writeConnectionSecretToRef.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      fmt: "appstack-rds-conn-%s"
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.endpoint
                toFieldPath: status.dbEndpoint

          # ---------------------------------------------------------------
          # IAM Role for Service Accounts (IRSA / OIDC trust)
          # ---------------------------------------------------------------
          - name: iam-role
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Role
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  # assumeRolePolicy templated below via patch
                  assumeRolePolicy: |
                    {}
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
              # Build OIDC trust policy scoped to the specific ServiceAccount.
              # Uses combine to inject provider ARN, url, namespace, and SA name.
              - type: CombineFromComposite
                combine:
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.oidcProviderArn
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.oidcProviderUrl
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.serviceAccountNamespace
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.serviceAccountName
                  strategy: string
                  string:
                    fmt: |
                      {
                        "Version": "2012-10-17",
                        "Statement": [
                          {
                            "Effect": "Allow",
                            "Principal": { "Federated": "%s" },
                            "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                            "Condition": {
                              "StringEquals": {
                                "%s:sub": "system:serviceaccount:%s:%s",
                                "%s:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
                              }
                            }
                          }
                        ]
                      }
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy
                # NOTE: url is referenced twice ($2 and $2). Because combine
                # consumes variables positionally per '%s', we duplicate url
                # in the variables list below via a second policy composition.
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
                toFieldPath: status.roleArn

          # Least-privilege inline policy: scoped to this stack's bucket only.
          - name: iam-role-policy
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: RolePolicy
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  roleSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  policy: |
                    {}
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
              # Scope actions to the specific bucket ARN (no wildcards).
              - type: CombineFromComposite
                combine:
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucketName
                  strategy: string
                  string:
                    fmt: |
                      {
                        "Version": "2012-10-17",
                        "Statement": [
                          {
                            "Sid": "ListStackBucket",
                            "Effect": "Allow",
                            "Action": ["s3:ListBucket"],
                            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::%s"
                          },
                          {
                            "Sid": "ReadWriteStackObjects",
                            "Effect": "Allow",
                            "Action": [
                              "s3:GetObject",
                              "s3:PutObject",
                              "s3:DeleteObject"
                            ],
                            "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::%s/*"
                          }
                        ]
                      }
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policy

    # -------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Ensure composite readiness reflects all resources
    # -------------------------------------------------------------------
    - step: ready
      functionRef:
        name: function-auto-ready
```

> **Note on the OIDC trust policy `combine`:** `function-patch-and-transform`'s string `fmt` consumes variables positionally. Because `%s:sub` and `%s:aud` both need the OIDC URL, the cleanest approach is to pre-render the trust policy in an `EnvironmentConfig` or use `function-go-templating`. See the templating alternative below if your `fmt` positional count doesn't line up cleanly.

## 3. Function installations

```yaml
# functions.yaml
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Function
metadata:
  name: function-patch-and-transform
spec:
  package: xpkg.upbound.io/crossplane-contrib/function-patch-and-transform:v0.7.0
---
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Function
metadata:
  name: function-auto-ready
spec:
  package: xpkg.upbound.io/crossplane-contrib/function-auto-ready:v0.2.1
```

## 4. Per-environment ProviderConfigs (environment isolation)

Environment separation is achieved via **distinct ProviderConfigs** (different regions/accounts) selected by claim parameter — dev and prod never share managed-resource state.

```yaml
# providerconfig-dev.yaml
apiVersion: aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: ProviderConfig
metadata:
  name: aws-dev
spec:
  credentials:
    source: Secret
    secretRef:
      namespace: crossplane-system
      name: aws-creds-dev
      key: creds
---
# providerconfig-prod.yaml
apiVersion: aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: ProviderConfig
metadata:
  name: aws-prod
spec:
  credentials:
    source: Secret
    secretRef:
      namespace: crossplane-system
      name: aws-creds-prod
      key: creds
```

## 5. Claims (dev + prod)

```yaml
# claim-dev.yaml
apiVersion: platform.example.org/v1alpha1
kind: AppStack
metadata:
  name: app-dev
  namespace: dev
spec:
  providerConfigName: aws-dev
  parameters:
    environment: dev
    region: us-east-1
    bucketName: acme-app-assets-dev
    oidcProviderArn: arn:aws:iam::111111111111:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVXXXX
    oidcProviderUrl: oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/DEVXXXX
    serviceAccountNamespace: default
    serviceAccountName: app-sa
    database:
      instanceClass: db.t3.micro
      allocatedStorage: 20
      multiAZ: false
      masterUsername: appuser
  compositionSelector:
    matchLabels:
      provider: aws
  writeConnectionSecretToRef:
    name: app-dev-conn
---
# claim-prod.yaml
apiVersion: platform.example.org/v1alpha1
kind: AppStack
metadata:
  name: app-prod
  namespace: prod
spec:
  providerConfigName: aws-prod
  parameters:
    environment: prod
    region: us-east-1
    bucketName: acme-app-assets-prod
    oidcProviderArn: arn:aws:iam::222222222222:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PRODXXXX
    oidcProviderUrl: oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/PRODXXXX
    serviceAccountNamespace: default
    serviceAccountName: app-sa
    database:
      instanceClass: db.t3.medium
      allocatedStorage: 100
      multiAZ: true
      masterUsername: appuser
  compositionSelector:
    matchLabels:
      provider: aws
  writeConnectionSecretToRef:
    name: app-prod-conn
```

---

## Robust OIDC trust policy (recommended: go-templating)

The positional `%s` limitation with `fmt` makes the OIDC trust policy awkward (URL used twice). For production, add a `function-go-templating` step which handles named variables cleanly:

```yaml
# functions.yaml (add)
apiVersion: pkg.crossplane.io/v1beta1
kind: Function
metadata:
  name: function-go-templating
spec:
  package: xpkg.upbound.io/crossplane-contrib/function-go-templating:v0.6.0
```

Replace the `iam-role` resource's trust-policy patch by generating the Role in a templating step instead:

```yaml
    - step: render-iam
      functionRef:
        name: function-go-templating
      input:
        apiVersion: gotemplating.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: GoTemplate
        source: Inline
        inline:
          template: |
            {{- $p := .observed.composite.resource.spec.parameters }}
            apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
            kind: Role
            metadata:
              annotations:
                gotemplating.fn.crossplane.io/composition-resource-name: iam-role
            spec:
              providerConfigRef:
                name: {{ .observed.composite.resource.spec.providerConfigName }}
              forProvider:
                assumeRolePolicy: |
                  {
                    "Version": "2012-10-17",
                    "Statement": [{
                      "Effect": "Allow",
                      "Principal": { "Federated": "{{ $p.oidcProviderArn }}" },
                      "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                      "Condition": {
                        "StringEquals": {
                          "{{ $p.oidcProviderUrl }}:sub": "system:serviceaccount:{{ $p.serviceAccountNamespace }}:{{ $p.serviceAccountName }}",
                          "{{ $p.oidcProviderUrl }}:aud": "sts.amazonaws.com"
                        }
                      }
                    }]
                  }
```

If you use this templating step, remove the `iam-role` block from the P&T `Resources` list (keep `iam-role-policy`, which references it by controller ref) and order the pipeline: `render-iam` → `patch-and-transform` → `ready`.

---

## How it maps to the acceptance criteria

| Criterion | Implementation |
|---|---|
| **Bucket** | `BucketVersioning` (Enabled), `BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration` (AES256), `BucketPublicAccessBlock` (all four true) |
| **RDS** | `deletionProtection: true`, `backupRetentionPeriod: 7`, `publiclyAccessible: false`, `storageEncrypted: true`, `skipFinalSnapshot: false` |
| **Secret** | DB password auto-generated by AWS provider, written to a namespaced connection Secret (`writeConnectionSecretToRef`) — never in Git. Store the source AWS creds via SOPS/SealedSecrets in `crossplane-system`. |
| **IAM least privilege** | Inline policy scoped to `arn:aws:s3:::<bucket>` and `/*` only; specific actions, no `s3:*` or `Resource: *`; OIDC trust scoped to a single ServiceAccount subject |
| **Env isolation** | Separate `ProviderConfig` (`aws-dev`/`aws-prod`) selected per-claim → independent MR state; changing prod claim never touches dev-owned resources |
| **Sizing** | `db.t3.micro`/single-AZ (dev) vs `db.t3.medium`/multi-AZ (prod) via claim parameters |

**Scope note:** EKS cluster, CloudFront/ACM HTTPS, and cross-region S3 replication are part of the broader spine but were not requested in this task's three deliverables; they'd be added as additional composed resources (`eks.Cluster` + `NodeGroup`, `cloudfront.Distribution` + `acm.Certificate`, `s3.BucketReplicationConfiguration`) following the same patterns shown here.
